posts.title: MixTape: A Postmortem
posts.description: MixTape is a program developed by bucketofwetsocks. According to the GitHub page , it's a Windows-only Electron app that is designed to "[build] and [play] curated mixes of Super Mario World ROM hacks." There are two modes of operation.
